verdict: No significant, material deterioration versus the baseline. The location and cause sections describe the background pattern of the (few) problem arrivals, not a new issue.

evidence: [A] 100% of late trains were already late at Hoyt-Schermerhorn Sts (inherited delay). Origins: at or before Grant Av: 12, at or before Hoyt-Schermerhorn Sts: 1, at or before Broadway Junction: 1, at Euclid Av: 1. Largest time loss on segment Nostrand Av -> Hoyt-Schermerhorn Sts (median +65s vs schedule).
[A] 86% of headway gaps at the target already existed at Hoyt-Schermerhorn Sts.

89% of hours with problems ran fewer than 90% of scheduled trains (overall service delivered 61%): cancellations or missing trips are creating gaps.
ETAs for problem arrivals drifted 196s on average vs 110s otherwise (1.8x): trains are being held or re-dispatched upstream.

recommendations.action: Fill cancelled trips on A, C during the affected hours: check crew availability and car assignments
recommendations.rationale: Fewer trains than scheduled are running in the problem hours.
recommendations.expected_effect: Restores scheduled headways; largest APT lever available.

recommendations.action: Review merge priority and dispatch spacing at Hoyt-Schermerhorn Sts, where C trains run ahead of A trains bound for Jay St-MetroTech
recommendations.rationale: Arrivals following a train of another route are disproportionately delayed.
recommendations.expected_effect: Fewer merge conflicts; smoother headways for both services.

recommendations.action: Check weekend / late-night planned service changes for A, C; use alternates F, FX
recommendations.rationale: Planned work is announced in advance.

recommendations.action: Adjust the schedule so C and A slots are offset by at least half a headway at Hoyt-Schermerhorn Sts
recommendations.expected_effect: Structural fix that survives day-to-day variability.

recommendations.action: Review the general-order (planned work) schedule for A, C; add supplement trains or move work windows off the affected hours
recommendations.rationale: Problems coincide with planned service changes.
recommendations.expected_effect: Planned changes stop degrading the analysed hours.

recommendations.action: Set a gap-filling rule: dispatch the next available train from Ozone Park-Lefferts Blvd when a gap over 13 min forms
recommendations.rationale: A fifth of arrivals follow a large gap.
recommendations.expected_effect: Caps the longest waits, which dominate the APT metric.

recommendations.action: Review dispatcher holding practice upstream of Jay St-MetroTech; consider publishing hold reasons in the feed
recommendations.rationale: ETAs drift substantially before problem arrivals, indicating holds.
recommendations.expected_effect: Fewer discretionary holds; more accurate countdown clocks.
